plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Exit all other leveraged single-name positions (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) to reduce risk.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single-name concentration limit.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return with a focus on capital preservation. Expect significantly reduced volatility and drawdown potential. Returns will be lower than other modes.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name concentration limit.
Reduce exposure to all leveraged ETFs and single-name leveraged positions (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to small allocations.
Introduce a new position in ALAB at 4%, a strong scanner setup.
This plan balances growth with risk management, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and limited leverage. Expect moderate volatility and drawdown potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name concentration limit.
Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs and single-name leveraged positions (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to press growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. Expect significantly higher volatility and drawdown potential, as leveraged ETFs decay daily. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage risk.

plan: To prioritize income, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Exit all other leveraged single-name positions (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) to reduce risk.
Increase QQQI to 30% to enhance monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on stable income and low drawdown, acting as a cash-like alternative.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. Growth potential is minimal, and NAV can still fall in market downturns. Distributions are variable and not guaranteed.
